name: io.arcnm/arcnm-pay
title: ARCNM pay
description: CAD part manufacturing cost, EUR 0.89 per calculation: pay per call in USDC, no account

tools.name: price_parts
tools.description: Price CAD parts (STEP or DXF, base64) and buy their manufacturing cost: EUR 0.89 per made part per environment, VAT included, no account; bought and catalogue parts are free. One file (file_base64) or many (items), at most 16 MB a call as base64 (more: POST /pay/price); offer_id alone: an earlier offer, without the file; neither: the environments, parameters, limits and unit price, free. Answers: unpaid, an error whose structured content is the x402 payment requirement with offer.offer_id and pay_url (pay in _meta['x402/payment'] with the same arguments, or over HTTP at pay_url); paid, status paid with purchase_id and result_token, or status running or settling to read with get_result; status pricing: call again. Billable only when paid; a failed calculation is not charged.

file_base64.description: The CAD file (STEP or DXF) as base64, or a data: URI; gzip-compressed is accepted.
file_base64.title: File Base64

drawing_base64.description: A drawing of the part: not read and not kept, the price is the geometry's (the offer's item says so in `drawing`).
drawing_base64.title: Drawing Base64

anyOf.description: An environment and the version to price it at.

version.description: The version; only the current one is priced. Omit it for the current one.
version.title: Version

anyOf.title: EnvironmentReference

environments.description: Up to 16 environments to price in, in order (the first is the baseline): ids price_parts lists when called with no arguments, `id@version`, or `{id, version}`. Default: DE-BY.
environments.title: Environments

lot_size.description: Pieces per lot the run is priced at. Default: 1.
lot_size.title: Lot Size

lot_sizes.description: The lots the answer states, at most 12. Default: 1, 10, 100 and 1000.
lot_sizes.title: Lot Sizes

currency.description: ISO 4217: each environment states its prices in it with its own rates. Default: each environment's own.
currency.title: Currency

sheet_gauge_mm.description: Sheet thickness in millimetres: with `material`, required for a DXF flat pattern.
sheet_gauge_mm.title: Sheet Gauge Mm

costing_date.description: Not used yet: an offer is priced as of the day it runs.
costing_date.title: Costing Date

vat_id.description: Your EU VAT ID, for an invoice that names it. The price is the same; the VAT inside it follows where you are (a VAT ID is not verified yet).
vat_id.title: Vat Id

invoice_to.description: Who the invoice names: name and address. The price is the same.
invoice_to.title: Invoice To

file_base64.description: The CAD file (STEP or DXF) as base64, or a data: URI; gzip-compressed is accepted.
file_base64.title: File Base64

sheet_gauge_mm.description: Sheet thickness in millimetres: with `material`, required for a DXF flat pattern.
sheet_gauge_mm.title: Sheet Gauge Mm

items.description: Many files in one offer and one payment, each with its own file_base64, filename, material and sheet_gauge_mm.

inputSchema.description: A CAD file sent as base64, with any of the optional parameters.
inputSchema.title: PriceRequestJSON

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Read a paid purchase with its purchase_id and result_token: the summary (every item in every environment at the lots asked, the cheapest environment per lot) and the receipt; view=full for one cell or component in full, a page at a time. Answers: status running or settling with progress (call again), then status paid; a purchase that still owes an amount answers the payment requirement with pay_url for exactly that. Read-only and free.

result_token.description: The result_token the paid answer carried (30 days).

component.description: One component, by its key in `components`.

view.description: `summary` (default): items, cells and lots. `full`: a cell (or with `component`, a component) as `GET /calculations/{id}` states it. `cost_sheet`: the itemised sheet of a part or a component at `lot_size`.

lot_sizes.description: Lots to state, comma separated: a part is restated at any lot, free; an assembly states the lots it was priced at.

tools.name: preview_cost
tools.description: What-if on a paid result: what one part or component of it costs at another lot size, as its itemised cost sheet at lot_size, from the paid result; nothing new is calculated. Answers: status paid, view cost_sheet, with the item, environment and lot_size it states. Read-only and free.

result_token.description: The result_token the paid answer carried (30 days).

component.description: One component, by its key in `components`.
